Acceptance sketch: Circle and plane through centre gives 2 points | w0-rw5-ghgeo: node(s) Curve x Plane (new; outputs Points, Parameters) in dino8-app/src/flow/FlowNodesIntersect.cpp; app section GCXP (dino8-app/tests/sections/97_gcxp.sh, generated by dino8-app/tests/flowgeo_gen.py) asserts against independent closed forms: the circle of radius 3 about the origin and the plane x = 0: 2 points, (0,3,0) then (0,-3,0) in curve order; the plane x = 1: (1, sqrt 8, 0) then (1,-sqrt 8, 0) (1 + 8 = 9); the plane x = 5: none; the line (0,0,0)-(0,0,10) and the plane z = 4: (0,0,4); the closed polyline (0,0),(6,0),(6,4),(0,4) and the plane x = 3: (3,0,0) and (3,4,0).
